تسترضون (form X)
# تَسْتَرْضُونَ (tastarḍūna) /tas.tar.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# تُسْتَرْضَوْنَ (tustarḍawna) /tus.tar.dˤaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
